title: [FEATURE] Support for Visual Studio Code "Next Edit Suggestions"
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

I found the usefulness of Github Copilot's implementation of this feature to be helpful, but not enough to pay for it.  Since I do pay for Claude, I'd love to see it be able to support this feature alongside the chat features it already does.

### Proposed Solution

Claude extension for VS Code supports inline code edit suggestions.

### Alternative Solutions

I think I can use the Continue extension, either with Haiku (via Ollama) or a self-hosted model, but it'd be better if the Claude extension could do this natively.

### Priority

Medium - Would be very helpful

### Feature Category

Developer tools/SDK
